hypothesis: Known rigid marker spacing resolves color aliases without introducing associations when the yellow marker is visually absent.
study_unit: Two fixed Go trajectories: zero residual and the final one-hour policy. Images from the final policy were not used to implement association. Frame samples within a trajectory are correlated.
sampling: Every100ms from4.4 through10.9s plus10.98s; nearest archived1kHz pose, no interpolation or integration. Same immutable frames/surveys and seeds per observer.
negative_control: Hide only the true yellow marker or football by making its visual geometry transparent before rendering, identically for both methods; no physics integration occurs. No pixel truth/segmentation reaches an observer.
primary_outcomes: false pose with missing yellow marker
false ball detection with hidden ball
evaluation_only: Archived robot state positions the renderer and supplies separate localization error labels; never fed to localization or association.
claim_limits: Engineering stress levels are not calibrated real sensor distributions. No controller/physics success change, no catch success rate, no training replication claim. All conditions reported; source/frames/inputs hashed. Sealed50 throw test unused.
